verdict: No paid activity this period; Google Business Profile is your only live channel.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran on any channel, so every measurable result came from your Google Business Profile and organic search. Your profile generated 32 total actions — 2 calls, 22 direction requests, and 8 website clicks — across 23 active days, and engagement was up 25% week-over-week through mid-period. However, that lift reversed in the final three days (Sep 20–22), with zero GBP actions recorded, and Search Console clicks fell 33% in the same window, so organic visibility is softening heading into next week. With 178 website sessions and no recorded form conversions this period, the intake funnel is not producing leads at a measurable rate. Paid campaigns are the focus going forward; reactivating that channel is the direct path to lead volume.
